entries.name: OpenTravel 1.0 XML specification distribution
entries.versionBasis: Publisher form lists 2024A under OpenTravel 1.0. Release date and exact downloaded schema version are not verified.

licence.text: OpenTravel custom specification agreement; applicability/derivative grant review pending
licence.basis: Public agreement contains use/modification conditions and reciprocal patent provisions; no unrestricted ontology-derivative or payload-redistribution grant established.

norn.overlap: Travel reservations, inventory, rates and guest/traveller data; no Core authority.

priority.reason: Industry vertical outside the ERP core; later.

entries.name: OpenTravel 2.0 JSON/XML specification distribution
entries.versionBasis: Publisher form lists 2019A under OpenTravel 2.0. Do not confuse the newer architecture family with the newer 2024A 1.0 release label; exact date unverified.

licence.text: OpenTravel custom specification agreement; applicability/derivative grant review pending
licence.basis: Custom agreement is not a standard permissive licence; derivative model publication rights need artifact-specific review.

norn.overlap: Travel objects and service message contracts remain industry-owned schemas, separately versioned from the 1.0 family.

priority.reason: Industry vertical outside the ERP core; later.
